prompt: A farm scene with animals and farmers. A farmer is feeding four chickens from a bucket while standing in a coop. The chickens are pecking at grain scattered on the ground. A cow is grazing in a field next to the coop. The farmer feeding the chickens is an old man with a grey beard, appearing much older than the farmer's daughter. A farm dog is herding a group of sheep toward a barn in the distance; the number of sheep is one more than the number of chickens. The sheep are following the dog. A farmer's daughter is milking a cow in a separate stall, sitting on a stool with a milk pail beneath the cow. Behind the barn, a tractor is pulling a hay wagon. Next to the wagon, three hay bales sit on the ground. The wagon is loaded with a number of hay bales double the number on the ground. The tractor driver is wearing overalls and pointing at storm clouds gathering in the sky. A rooster is perched on a fence post. A pitchfork is leaning against the barn wall next to a wheelbarrow.
